observations.summary: The paper reports a lower solidus from combined in situ channels than earlier comparisons; contradictory temperature corrections remain unresolved.
Shear response weakens with melting; absent measurable shear arrival is not zero velocity. Buffer-side reverberation is not a sample shear observation.
Low-degree deep melts are iron-rich. The S3631 melt composition used downstream is calculated rather than directly measured.
Buoyancy comparisons depend on distinct liquid and solid models and source assumptions; no density is directly measured by this conversion.
A long-lived Martian basal layer is an interpretation consistent with some geophysical models, not an experimentally observed Martian layer.
